iterate_commute:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [iterate_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [iterate_succ, iterate_succ, ih]
reaches_predecessor:
by
  rcases hx with ⟨k, hk⟩
  refine ⟨k + 1, ?_⟩
  calc
    iterate f (k + 1) x = f (iterate f k x) := iterate_succ f k x
    _ = iterate f k (f x) := (iterate_commute f k x).symm
    _ = one := hk
